mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs (company_id, title, description, requirements, contact_phone, location, province, city, district, address, latitude, longitude, category_id, headcount, status, deadline, image_url) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{contactPhone}, #{location}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{categoryId}, #{headcount}, #{status}, #{deadline}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE jobs SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, requirements = #{requirements}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, location = #{location}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, category_id = #{categoryId}, headcount = #{headcount}, deadline = #{deadline}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
